240.method: Block-prequential: train only on earlier decisions with immutable records and verified labels available at each block-start cutoff; freeze predictions within block. Estimators share assignments, scoring cutoffs and Beta(1,1). Recent windows use decision age, not verification arrival age. Binary scores use labels mature at evaluation_at; simulator truth only evaluates current latent probability. Equal-tail Beta intervals have 95% posterior mass under a constant-p model, with no nominal nonstationary coverage claim. Coverage weights decision assignments; macro coverage weights represented cells. Repeated blocks/cells are dependent; distributions use independent seeds. Tail is last quarter of scored decision span. Adaptation is first of three consecutive blocks with assignment-weighted probability MAE <= 0.1 after drift finishes; unobserved recovery is censored, not assigned a zero delay.
240.artifact_note: Condensed synthetic evidence: complete API reports retain block traces and calibration bins; this saved artifact retains seed summaries, final sample counts and reproducible configurations.
